scripts.lighthouse: pnpm build && (pnpm dlx serve .vercel/output/static -l 4321 -s > /dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! > .preview.pid; sleep 3; pnpm dlx lighthouse http://localhost:4321 --preset=desktop --quiet --chrome-flags='--headless' --output=json --output-path=./lighthouse.json; kill $(cat .preview.pid); rm -f .preview.pid; node -e "const r=require('./lighthouse.json').categories;for(const k in r)console.log(k.padEnd(16),Math.round(r[k].score*100))")
